# sipswpcalculator.com

> Free SIP & SWP Calculator with step-up compounding for Indian mutual fund investors.

## Calculators
- [SIP & SWP Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/): Combined SIP accumulation and SWP retirement withdrawal planner with step-up compounding
- [SWP Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/swp-calculator): Standalone Systematic Withdrawal Plan calculator with annual step-up withdrawals
- [SIP Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/sip-calculator): Standalone Systematic Investment Plan calculator with step-up top-up compounding
- [Step-Up SIP Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/sip-step-up-calculator): Top-up SIP compounding calculator to model annual increment impacts
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/lumpsum-calculator): One-time mutual fund investment compound interest return calculator
- [Retirement Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/retirement-calculator): Dual-phase SIP accumulation to SWP pension drawdown planner
- [1 Crore SIP Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/my-first-crore-calculator): Reverse-engineer required monthly SIP to reach ₹1 Crore
- [Target Corpus Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/target-corpus-calculator): Calculate required monthly SIP for custom financial wealth goals
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/compound-interest-calculator): Calculate periodic compounding returns across annual, quarterly, and monthly frequencies
- [CAGR Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/cagr-calculator): Calculate compound annual growth rate, absolute returns, and wealth multipliers for investments
- [EMI Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/emi-calculator): Calculate monthly loan EMIs and complete year-by-year amortization schedules for home and car loans
- [Inflation Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/inflation-calculator): Project future cost of living and purchasing power loss over 5 to 30 year horizons
- [PPF Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/ppf-calculator): Calculate Public Provident Fund interest, 5th-of-the-month rules, and 15 to 30 year block extension schedules
- [FD Calculator](https://sipswpcalculator.com/fd-calculator): Calculate bank fixed deposit interest, quarterly compounding, senior citizen bonuses, and Section 194A TDS

## Core Features & Mechanics
- All financial calculations execute client-side in the browser with zero latency and zero server roundtrips
- Full Indian Rupee (₹) localization with Lakh and Crore formatting conventions
- Annual Step-Up Compounding: 0% to 50% annual top-up on monthly SIP investments
- Month-by-month financial simulation parity between PHP and TypeScript engines
- Post-tax capital gains estimation incorporating Indian LTCG and STCG tax rules
- Inflation-adjusted real corpus and real purchasing power projections
- Free instant CSV data export and branded PDF projection report downloads
